title: Sum of Scores of Built Strings
summary: Construct a string s of length n by adding characters to the front, then calculate the sum of the longest common prefixes between each prefix of s and the full string s.
statement: Construct a string s of length n by adding characters to the front, then calculate the sum of the longest common prefixes between each prefix of s and the full string s.
constraints: For each suffix s[i:], its score is the longest prefix it shares with the full string.
Include the full string itself, whose score is len(s).
Return the sum of all suffix scores.
hints: The desired suffix-prefix match lengths are precisely the Z-array values.
Maintain the rightmost known matching interval and reuse its earlier Z values before extending by direct comparisons.
Compute z[1:] with the standard [left,right] window, then return len(s)+sum(z).
The Z invariant records the longest prefix match at every suffix start; adding all entries and the full-string length is exactly the requested score sum.
